name: app.playsnack/playsnack
title: PlaySnack
description: Party games for groups: game picks, rules, and a room link everyone joins on their own phone.

tools.name: recommend_games
tools.description:
Recommends PlaySnack party games for a group of a given size (friends, coworkers, a class, family), optionally matching a mood and a length in minutes. Each game runs in a phone's web browser, with everyone on their own phone, in one place or apart. Returns up to 5 games, best match first, each with its game_id (the input of get_game and open_friend_room), player range, length and page link; note explains when the group is larger than a friends room.
인원·분위기·시간에 맞는 PlaySnack 파티 게임을 최대 5개 추천합니다(각자 폰 브라우저로 해요).

minutes.description: Roughly how long they want to play.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description:
Lists every PlaySnack game with its game_id, title, player range, length and page link — for browsing, or for finding a game_id by name. together_only: true keeps only the games played together, each on their own phone.
PlaySnack 게임 전체 목록(game_id·이름·인원·시간).

together_only.description: Only games played together, each on their own phone.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description:
Returns one game's rules in a few sentences (how a round goes), its player range, length and what it suits. game_id comes from list_games or recommend_games.
게임 한 개의 규칙·인원·시간.

game_id.description: A game_id from list_games or recommend_games.

tools.name: open_friend_room
tools.description:
Opens a private PlaySnack room for one game. Returns one join link (join_url) that everyone in the group uses and a QR page (qr_url) for people in the same place. A room holds up to 10 phones; joining needs no account. The first person to open join_url becomes the host, who starts the game (or spins the wheel); anyone else with the link joins the same room. join_url works only exactly as returned: its query and its #fragment are part of the room. Each call opens a new room.
Content games (vote-maker: a poll; wheel-fortune: a roulette wheel) open ready with the list in content, and the server requires the user's approval of that list before it opens a room: without content → status needs_content with content_shape (the fields and an example); with content but without confirmed: true → status needs_confirmation with the cleaned list the room will use (what cleaning changed is in content_notes), and no room is opened; the same content with confirmed: true → the room opens with that list. Other games that are written first return status maker_link with make_url, where the user writes their questions. Other statuses: solo_only (one-phone game, solo_url), rooms_full_today and busy (retry_after), slow (retry_in seconds).
게임 하나로 친구방(최대 10명)을 열고 모두가 쓰는 참여 링크(join_url)와 QR 페이지를 돌려줍니다. 링크를 먼저 연 사람이 방장이에요. 투표(vote-maker)·룰렛(wheel-fortune)은 content의 목록으로 열리고, 정리된 목록을 needs_confirmation으로 먼저 돌려준 뒤 confirmed: true로 다시 불렀을 때만 방이 열려요.

game_id.description: A game_id from recommend_games or list_games.

content.description: The list a content game opens with. vote-maker: {question, options} — e.g. {"question": "점심 뭐 먹지?", "options": ["김치찌개", "돈가스", "쌀국수"]} (2+ options). wheel-fortune: {items, title?} — e.g. {"title": "벌칙", "items": ["노래하기", "커피 사기", "통과"]} (2+ items; each item is short, up to 16 characters).

items.description: wheel-fortune: the wheel's segments, in order.

title.description: wheel-fortune: an optional name shown above the wheel.

confirmed.description: true = the user approved the exact list returned with needs_confirmation; the room then opens with it. Absent or false = no room; the cleaned list comes back for approval.
